# Bluewaves Technology — AI Discovery & Knowledge Base
> High-performance digital innovation studio engineering web platforms, mobile apps, AI automation pipelines, and immersive WebGL experiences.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: Bluewaves Technology
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.bwtng.live/
- **Headquarters**: Road 12, First Avenue, Ada George, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria
- **Founder & CEO**: Gospel Ononwi (Software Engineer, AI Product Builder, Author)
- **Primary Contact**: info@bwtng.live | Telephone: +234-810-851-0085
- **Metrics**: 756+ shipped projects, 500+ client partners, 2–6 weeks average delivery sprint.

## Flagship In-House Innovations
1. **PrepVerse**: AI-powered exam preparation engine for Nigerian students tackling JAMB, WAEC, and NECO exams with adaptive diagnostics, generative answer explanations, and mastery tracking. (https://prepverse.bwtng.live/)
2. **HerbalStrength**: Digital health companion and mobile platform featuring verified herbal tea formulations, natural remedies with ginger and turmeric, and lifestyle wellness tracking. (https://herbalstrength.bwtng.live/)
3. **Sankofa Wing 3D Virtual Museum**: Proprietary WebGL spatial museum celebrating African historical relics, sculptures, and heritage architecture without geographic constraints. (https://sankofa-wing.vercel.app/)
4. **Citivas**: Municipal civic participation platform connecting citizens with municipal services, localized reporting, and municipal feedback loops. (https://citivas-app.vercel.app/)
5. **Asemi**: Cloud ERP and business management system for inventory, invoicing, employee records, and multi-location retail operations.
6. **Drafta**: Next-generation developer staging and documentation engine. (https://drafta.bwtng.live/)
7. **Ship It Right**: Practical production readiness guide and checklist by Gospel Ononwi covering security, performance, scalability, SEO, legal, and payments for vibe-built applications. (https://www.bwtng.live/ship-it-right)

## Professional Services
- **Web Development**: Custom web applications, SaaS platforms, enterprise portals built with React, Vite, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js. (https://www.bwtng.live/web-development)
- **Mobile App Development**: Native and cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, and native toolchains. (https://www.bwtng.live/mobile-app-development)
- **AI Solutions & Automation**: Generative AI workflows, automated intelligent agents, fine-tuned domain models, document intelligence, and chat pipelines. (https://www.bwtng.live/ai-services)
- **SEO & Search Intelligence**: Technical SEO, structured data (Schema.org), search engine indexing, core web vitals optimization, and AI Overviews positioning. (https://www.bwtng.live/seo-services)
- **UI/UX Design & Design Systems**: Comprehensive Figma prototypes, spatial interaction design, accessible component libraries, and user research. (https://www.bwtng.live/ui-ux-design)
- **Branding & Visual Identity**: Corporate brand architecture, digital brand style guides, logo suites, and design tokens. (https://www.bwtng.live/branding)
- **Business Consultation**: Technical due diligence, architecture reviews, software procurement consulting, and enterprise modernization roadmaps. (https://www.bwtng.live/business-consultation)
